entries.reason: Realtime fog splits density/velocity, optical profile, derived caches and art so each mutable fact has one writer.
entries.state: FogDensityField and MacFluidGrid own media; FogProfile owns optical constants; BeerLightCache is a derived cache; ContinuousArtParams are presentation-only.
entries.authoritative_owner: FogSystem orchestrates writes; ContinuousArt never writes density, velocity, extinction or transmittance.
entries.projections: Froxel AtmosphereVolume, BeerLightCache, FogRayResult and ContinuousArtOutput are invalidatable projections of the density/optics owners.

entries.reason: FogSystem is a domain orchestrator, not an ECS view walker; this contract records its lattice access, injected time and deferred cache invalidation.
entries.entity_scope: MAC lattice cells and analytic FogSolidProxy records owned by FogSystem; no ECS entity traversal
entries.view: cell-centered density plus face-centered MAC velocity; interactor rasterization completes before advection
entries.read_set: FogDensityField, FogProfile, SceneWind targets, FogSolidProxy geometry and AtmosphereVolume froxel dimensions
entries.write_set: MAC velocity/pressure/density, FogDensityField bands, BeerLightCache and AtmosphereVolume media during inject/integrate
entries.structural_changes: none while marching or integrating; domain resize and proxy replacement are explicit caller-owned Result operations
entries.events: CFL reports and cache version bumps after a successful step; art stylize emits no simulation events
entries.services: injected wall-clock dt accumulated into a fixed substep, named dust seed, and borrowed AtmosphereVolume for display mapping
entries.phase: simulation step before rendering; froxel inject/integrate and ContinuousArt run after physics transport

entries.reason: Changed import faces retain backend-owned shared textures and explicit foliage material state; existing faces are unchanged.

provides.absent_behavior: Default newSharedTexture reports Unsupported; no implicit uncached allocation.

requires.fallback: Borrowed only during upload; invalid input returns InvalidArgument.

entries.thread_affinity: Graphics owner thread; upload and material preparation do not invoke callbacks.

trim.absent_profile: No new trim claim: graphics is required by this visual project; reduced backend profiles require separate builds.

cost_notes.why: ResultRef borrows backend cache ownership; upload cost is paid on first model preparation, never in a frame loop.
